resources.string: Shows the “Install with…” window at every install point (files, clouds, network, links, updates, rollback). Off: the saved choice or the default installer is used at once (ADB-phon with ADB/root, otherwise the system one); the window with versions and the progress of ADB-phon stay.
Only the app itself can install several files at once
The file is on the device: only ADB-phon can install it
Remember: the “Install with…” window is then no longer shown; to bring it back turn on Settings → “Ask which installer to use”.
